entries.en:
Though Lydirceil is keen to see your phantom weapon stripped of its illusory trappings, Gerolt is already having misgivings. Despite the success of the previous test, the weaponsmith divulges that he noticed a slight aetherial imbalance in Lydirceil's armor resulting from the Phantom Philleter. Leery of leaving the issue unaddressed, Gerolt resolves to rebuild the core of your weapon and thus counteract any discrepancies. Sadly, this requires three chunks of ecliptic arcanite, and, presumably, a significant outlay of tomestones. Once you have completed the transaction, Dodokkuli will be waiting to receive the ore for initial processing.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

※Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.

entries.en: The diminutive metallurgist deftly completes his preparations and hands the processed ore to Gerolt. Brandishing the knife with enthusiasm, the grizzled weaponsmith slices through the illusion wreathing your phantom weapon. Although the weapon's true form has been revealed, Gerolt is determined to “squeeze every last drop o' potential” out of his creation, and bids you channel memories of battle into it to help him achieve his vision. Exactly what he means by this, however, remains to be seen...
entries.fr: Une fois le nouveau noyau ajouté à votre arme fantôme, Gerolt a finalement pu dissiper les illusions qui empêchaient celle-ci d'exprimer tout son potentiel. Maintenant que l'arme a retrouvé sa forme originelle, le forgeron semble convaincu que vos souvenirs de combats les plus marquants sont la clef d'une future amélioration... Quelle idée farfelue a-t-elle encore germé dans son esprit<nbsp>?

entries.en: When I sliced through the glamour earlier, yer armor's aetherial balance shifted slightly askew. At first I didn't pay it much heed, but on reflection, there's no tellin' how the phantom weapon'll react.

entries.en: So here's me plan: reformulate the weapon's core to channel aether into a single focal point. That'll negate the minor imbalance caused by the Philleter, an' ensure the weapon attains its true form.
entries.fr: Heu<->reu<->se<->ment, j'ai pensé à une solution<nbsp>: on va reconstruire son noyau pour que l'éther s'y concentre. Avec ça, l'arme devrait retrouver sa forme originelle sans aucune perturbation.
entries.ja:
そこで、武器の核となる部分を新たに作り、
エーテルが1箇所に収斂するようにしたい。
そうすれば、完璧な状態で真の姿が暴かれるはずだ。

武器の核にするには最適なものでな、それが3個もありゃ十分だ。

entries.en: Ye might've turned to ancient wisdom for inspiration, but in the end, it was that brilliant rum-brined brain o' yers that made the real advances. I reckon it's fair to say yer the best damned blacksmith of our age!
entries.fr: Dans ces moments-là, on est forcés de s'incliner. Le mélange entre les techniques anciennes et ton ingéniosité est redoutable... Il faut bien le reconnaître, tu es le plus grand forgeron de notre époque<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
古の匠の技術を学び、積み重ねながらも、
最後にそれをすべて打ち砕く大胆な発想……。
当代随一の名工の知識と経験は、伊達じゃねえな！

entries.en: Fittin' that me creations are wielded by the fiercest fighter of our times, then! Say, here's an idea: why don't ye channel some o' yer most valiant memories o' battle into that phantom weapon?
entries.fr: Dis, toi qui as une longue expérience de mes créations, et qui leur fais toujours honneur sur le champ de bataille... Qu'est-ce que tu dirais d'insuffler tes souvenirs de combats les plus marquants dans ton arme fantôme<nbsp>?

武器を振るうことにかけちゃ、テメェの右に出るものはいねえ。
どうせなら、その記憶も上乗せしてみねえか？
